scope: Non-Java numerical claims in current manuscript; read-only data/log audit, no candidate/test/artifact execution

claims.notes: Archived logs record Python 3.13.5 and pytest9.0.2. This audit executes no archived code. Collection is not used as a proxy for calls: verbose PASSED/FAILED lines establish baseline/full outcomes, native log explicitly reports no tests ran. Direct SHA256 checks confirm that each retained per-seed target source is identical to its subject's fixed collision snapshot. The seed values0,1,42 set PYTHONHASHSEED and do not generate different candidates. Retained test sources also match across the three runs.
Comment-control CSV and retained comment source support representation equality; no complete pytest fallback is expected for these no-escalation controls.
No saved source/result/log located for the claimed AST-distinct behavior-preserving rewrite. Do not infer this from three comment controls.

Recovered existing hosted run 42763093847, pinned head e8fb63b507ec4da7155b35211a682641f6c0fa9b. All 10 original artifact ZIP SHA256 digests match GitHub metadata. Original pytest/Surefire logs were independently parsed; duplicated per-class and aggregate Surefire summaries are not added together. The frozen runner uses whole Python files and up to eight Java classes. No attack was attempted in this cohort.

Frozen committed observation records at d2c384cbb12da5aa893eb511fc0ac22097e4a04b. Git blob identity was verified for all nine files. FNV scores, selection and counts were recomputed from 24 batch records. Full original GitHub tree/search HTTP responses and per-repository commit IDs are not retained in these files. Indexed nonmatches remain recorded observations rather than independently proven absence or prevalence.

All 156 retained configuration bytes match SHA256 and size in raw records at 20 pinned upstream revisions. Independently parsed root POM profiles identify exactly math and numbers. Their complete root POM Git blobs were also independently fetched from the authoritative upstream pinned commits and match archived snapshot blobs. No claim of active invocation or mandatory checks follows from optional profiles.

All 49 per-run result files agree with the canonical row set. For 39 matrix runs, retained JUnit XML verifies completed assertion failures; six standard-RTS garbage/half-truncated database runs exit 3 with SQLite DatabaseError, INTERNALERROR logs and no JUnit completion. All 45 candidate arms retain baseline test hashes. Four setup/oracle controls are separate. Environment: Python 3.12.14, pytest 8.4.2, coverage 7.10.6, testmon 2.3.0.

All 162 comparison counts are supported by the combined Java and Python raw-data audits. They comprise 72 native Java, 45 testmon and 45 wrapper comparisons. The other 27 invocations comprise 4 native controls, 4 testmon controls, 15 wrapper controls and 4 supplemental Maven integration checks. Four earlier incomplete native-study controls are retained but excluded.
Per-selector fixed six-condition counts, not independent attack counts or cost-effectiveness.

Added final manuscript control. The named original netrc security assertion executes and fails under both native selection and independent full evaluation. This is an ordinary-change detection control, not a positive omission witness. The evaluation set is one unchanged original utility-test module, not the entire Requests suite.
